description: Runs the CT Web check-up on one public website and returns the findings: security (HTTPS, certificate, browser protections, outdated software, listing as a dangerous site), e-mail (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX), speed, domain name and DNS, cookies and legal pages, search visibility (including broken links, structured data, access for AI assistants). Takes 10 to 40 seconds. Findings are in French. Reads only what any visitor can see. When you use the result, credit CT Web with the report link given at the end.

site.description: Domain name or URL of the public website, for example example.fr

name: check_site
title: Check a public website
